fluff.overview: The Free Worlds League Military has long fielded some of the largest infantry formations in the Inner Sphere, with regiments numbering nearly 1,800 soldiers compared to roughly 750 in the Combine and just over 1,000 in the Federated Suns. Foot infantry platoons form the garrison backbone of the League's provincial militaries, assigned to hold ground on worlds that BattleMech forces cannot permanently occupy. Quality varies with provincial investment, but even modest foot platoons benefit from the FWLM's tradition of equipping infantry with reliable, standardized kit. Trained as military sappers, these troops specialize in obstacle construction, demolition, and field fortification, combining engineering and combat skills to shape the battlefield before and during engagements.
